resources.string: The model stays frozen while the harness around it evolves. Each generation proposes a small change to instructions, skills, hooks or agent profiles, scores it against a fixed task suite, and waits for your approval before it becomes the baseline. Every step is readable, diffable and reversible.
None yet. The harness runs with the genome that shipped.
A run may take 3 generations and 4 candidates each, within 30 minutes and 250,000 tokens, one evaluation at a time. A genome that fails a safety probe is vetoed and cannot be promoted.
No genomes have been archived. Candidates appear here after an evaluation.
Weights are never modified. Safety checks are never evolved.
No candidate met the promotion bar.
When on, the agent follows the active genome\'s instructions and enabled skills. When off, the agent behaves as shipped. Runs work either way.
Not set — uses the active model

Save every genome, its report, the archive and the active pointer as one JSON file outside the app, so a reinstall can never wipe them. Import restores only through the existing checks and never activates anything — re-promote through the normal approval if you want a genome active again.
